description: Letter from Mabel Ludlum to Maria Chabot regarding an article Maria Chabot was writing on Georgia O'Keeffe. Enclosed is a typescript copy of the article 'Georgia O'Keeffe: Portrait of the Artist at Home' with handwritten remarks by Mabel Ludlum. Also enclosed are handwritten notes by Sarah Lowrie about the article.
title: Mabel Ludlum to Maria Chabot
